subject: general
question: From which of the following countries India has purchased S-400 Missile System?
solution:
The correct answer is "__**Russia**__".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Now, along the Line of **Actual Control**, both China and India have placed their own **S-400 air defence systems**.
 
• By the end of 2023, **Russia** could provide India with **all five regiments of the S-400 air defence system.**
 
• According to the Russian ambassador, **Denis Alipov**, the delivery of the S-400 Triumf air defence missile systems to India is "**proceeding well**" and on schedule.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **Russia**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Only the S-400 is able to shield a significantly **bigger region** from threats that are farther away.
 
• To defend against **Chinese or Pakistani** fighter jet or missile assaults India wants S-400 missiles.
